name: 华兰生物
current_thesis: 华兰生物是血制品第一梯队中浆站效率较高、现金流较好且疫苗业务具备周期弹性的公司；当前估值进入可观察区，但 2026Q1 利润下滑、血制品毛利率和疫苗批签发尚需确认，因此评级为 watch，优先等待 10.5-12.0 元买入区和中报验证。

position_plan.condition: price <= 12.0 and no negative change in plasma collection, batch release, or regulatory status
position_plan.action: build initial watch position in 2-3 tranches
position_plan.reason: Current valuation is acceptable, but 2026Q1 profit still declined and the business needs confirmation.

position_plan.condition: price <= 11.5 and interim results confirm stable plasma collection and blood products margin above 48%
position_plan.action: increase position after reviewing interim report
position_plan.reason: Lower price provides a better margin of safety if the blood products core remains intact.

position_plan.condition: price <= 10.5 and decline is market-driven rather than caused by regulatory, quality, or pricing deterioration
position_plan.reason: At this level the implied valuation gives credit mainly to the blood products cash-flow base and little to vaccine recovery.

position_plan.condition: price >= 18.0 without evidence that 2026-2027 attributable profit can recover above CNY 1.1 billion
position_plan.reason: Upside would be largely priced in unless earnings recovery accelerates.

price_triggers.reason: Review for adding to the initial position if plasma collection and batch release indicators remain healthy.
Reassess whether the decline reflects fundamental damage or an attractive margin of safety.
Consider reducing unless earnings recovery and vaccine contribution justify a higher multiple.
Likely exceeds the base-case fair value range absent a bull-case rerating.

review_triggers.reason: Review 2026 interim report for plasma collection, blood products margin, vaccine revenue, and cash-flow quality.
Review 2026 third-quarter report and flu vaccine batch-release seasonality.
Review 2026 annual report, full-year plasma volume, dividend, and capital allocation.

key_tracking_metrics: annual plasma collection volume and year-on-year growth
blood products revenue and gross margin
human albumin and IVIG pricing trend
NIFDC batch release volume for key blood products and vaccines
Hualan Vaccine revenue, profit, and batch release pace
operating cash flow versus attributable net profit
dividend per share and payout ratio
new plasma station approvals or disruptions
